description: Pre-signing check for Base. Send a transaction (to, data, value, from) or a typed-data signature request and get what it does in plain words plus red flags: unlimited or wallet-targeted approvals, NFT approve-all, off-chain permits, sends to a token's own contract or the dead address, OFAC or scam-listed counterparties, risky tokens, and calls that would fail (simulated from your wallet). Verdict ok, caution, danger or block. Not charged for invalid input. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

from.description: Optional: the signing wallet 0x address. Lets the check simulate the call and compare balances.

to.description: Transaction destination 0x address (a contract or wallet). Omit when sending typedData.

typedData.description: Alternative to a transaction: the EIP-712 signature request (domain, primaryType, message) a site asks you to sign, as an object or JSON string.

value.description: Optional: ETH to send, in wei (decimal or 0x hex). Default 0.

name: tx_preflight
title: Should I sign this? Plain-words check of a Base transaction or signature request, with red flags
